SQL_STMT_U.val:
SELECT SUM(COALESCE(i.previous_balance,0)) AS total_previous_balance, SUM( COALESCE(i.reduced_sales_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.standard_sales_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.reduced_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.standard_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.reduced_discount_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.standard_discount_amount,0) ) AS total_sales_total, SUM(COALESCE(i.reduced_tax_amount,0) + COALESCE(i.standard_tax_amount,0)) AS total_tax, SUM(COALESCE(i.payment_amount,0)) AS total_payments, SUM(COALESCE(i.current_balance,0)) AS total_current_balance FROM invoice AS i WHERE i.billing_end_date = ':2' AND (:3 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :3) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer c WHERE (c.id = i.bill_to_customer_id OR c.billing_customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM closing_calculation cc WHERE cc.customer_id = c.billing_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :1 ) );
-- AND c.branch_type IN (0,1);

DELETE i FROM invoice AS i JOIN customer AS c ON c.id = i.bill_to_customer_id OR c.billing_customer_id = i.bill_to_customer_id WHERE i.billing_end_date = ':2' AND ( :3 = 0 OR i.bill_to_customer_id = :3 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM closing_calculation cc WHERE cc.customer_id = c.billing_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :1 );

UPDATE sale AS s JOIN customer AS c ON c.id = s.billing_customer_id SET s.billing_cutoff_date = NULL WHERE s.billing_cutoff_date = ':2' AND ( :3 = 0 OR s.billing_customer_id = :3 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM closing_calculation cc WHERE cc.customer_id = c.billing_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :1 );

UPDATE receipt AS r SET r.billing_cutoff_date = NULL WHERE r.billing_cutoff_date = ':2' AND ( :3 = 0 OR r.billing_customer_id = :3 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer AS c WHERE (c.id = r.billing_customer_id OR c.billing_customer_id = r.billing_customer_id) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM closing_calculation cc WHERE cc.customer_id = c.billing_customer_id AND cc.closing_day = :1 ) );
